    static long[][][][][] S = new long[65][35][35][35];

    static long[][][][][] P = new long[65][35][35][35];

    static class Pair {

        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static void copyMatrix(long[][] dest, long[][] src, long size) {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++)
                dest[i][j] = src[i][j];
    }

    static void modAdd(long[] x, int index, long y) {
        x[index] += y;
        if (x[index] >= MOD) x[index] -= MOD;
    }

    static void matrixMultiplyFunc(long[][] A, long[][] B, long[][] C, long n, long m, long p) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < p; j++) {
                C[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    long val = (A[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD;

        copyMatrix(P[0][0], A[0][0], K + 1);
        copyMatrix(S[0][(int)(K - 1)], A[0][(int)(K - 1)], K + 1);
        for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
            matrixMultiplyFunc(P[0][(int)(x - 1)], A[0][(int)x], P[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }
        for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {
            matrixMultiplyFunc(A[0][(int)x], S[0][(int)(x + 1)], S[0][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
        }
        long count = 1;
        for (long m = K; m <= N; m *= K, count++) {
            for (long x = 0; x < K; x++) {
                if (x > 0) {
                    copyMatrix(A[(int)count][(int)x], S[(int)(count - 1)][(int)x], K + 1);
                    long[][] AuxTemp = new long[(int)(K + 1)][(int)(K + 1)];
                    matrixMultiplyFunc(A[(int)count][(int)x], P[(int)(count - 1)][(int)(x - 1)], AuxTemp, K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
                    copyMatrix(A[(int)count][(int)x], AuxTemp, K + 1);

            copyMatrix(P[(int)count][0], A[(int)count][0], K + 1);
            copyMatrix(S[(int)count][(int)(K - 1)], A[(int)count][(int)(K - 1)], K + 1);
            for (long x = 1; x < K; x++) {
                matrixMultiplyFunc(P[(int)count][(int)(x - 1)], A[(int)count][(int)x], P[(int)count][(int)x], K + 1, K + 1, K + 1);
            }
            for (long x = K - 2; x >= 0; x--) {

            }
            if (m > N / K) break;
        }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        Power[0] = 1;

                copyMatrix(Res, ResTemp, K + 1);
                ind2++;

                init -= Power[iIdx];

        long ans = 0;

        }
        ans %= MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
